- Full-screen tldraw canvas with custom IdeaCard shape
- Client-side embedding generation using Xenova/all-MiniLM-L6-v2

- IndexedDB persistence for canvas state and vector index
- Web Worker for non-blocking ML inference

- Phase 1: Foundation \(tldraw canvas, custom shapes, persistence\)
- Phase 2: Embedding Pipeline \(Web Worker, queue system, progress UI\)
- Phase 3: Duplicate Detection \(vector index, cosine similarity, warnings\)

Technical Stack:
- React 19 + TypeScript + Vite
- tldraw v4 for infinite canvas
- Zustand for vector index state
- @xenova/transformers for embeddings
- idb-keyval for IndexedDB persistence
